moment_jump.derivation: With v_t=beta2*v_(t-1)+(1-beta2)*g_t^2, triangle inequality and ||g^2||_2<=||g||_2^2 give ||v_end||_2<=beta2^n*||v_start||_2+(1-beta2^n)*max_gradient_l2^2.
moment_jump.assumptions: Same coordinatewise raw second-moment recurrence for all tensors at every intervening update; real-arithmetic interpretation of recorded norm estimates.
moment_jump.roundoff_scope: Recorded Float32 norms are rounded; the approximate lower bound is not a certified floating-point bound or a directly observed gradient.
moment_jump.causality_scope: The jump indicates large gradients between probes under the raw recurrence, but does not locate the update, identify a trigger, or prove gradients caused the regression.
